name: Tápióság (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tápióság (a blue shield with a white church, ears of grain and a bird) below the name TÁPIÓSÁG in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
